headline: KnowBe4 Combats Voice-Based Threats With Advanced Simulated Vishing Capabilities
summary: TAMPA BAY, Fla., July 30, 2026--KnowBe4, the global leader in digital workforce security, securing both humans and AI agents, today announced its new simulated vishing capability designed to help organizations close what has become the fastest-growing gap in security awareness: the phone channel.
